worldcombat.skill.thrash.summary: Flail in place: every swing covers everyone around the user, dealing contact damage and hurling them outward, with a heavy stomp on the last one; afterwards the user reels in confusion and its actions may fumble.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.use.0: Cover everyone nearby in one move when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.thrash.use.1: Hurl the enemies on top of you away together
worldcombat.skill.thrash.use.2: Clear small targets around you with repeated area contact damage
worldcombat.skill.thrash.description.0: Flails %2$s times in place, each dealing %1$s power to everything around; the last stomp is multiplied by %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.description.1: The flail radius is %1$s blocks and swings are %2$s apart; a hit hurls everyone in the ring %3$s blocks outward, while the user staggers a random %4$s blocks each swing.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.description.2: Afterwards the user is confused for %1$s, and each attempted action has a %2$s chance to fumble and hurt itself.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.wild.on: Wild form: covers wider, hurls harder and stomps heavier, but every swing hurts the user, with a longer cooldown and daze.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.wild.off: Brawling form: only shakes, never self-harms, and recovers faster, but the radius and knockback are narrower.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.growth.0: From level %1$s each swing rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.growth.1: From level %1$s each swing rises to %2$s and the stomp to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.preference.wild: On: covers wider, hurls harder and stomps heavier, but every swing hurts the user, with a longer cooldown and daze - for being surrounded. Off (brawling): only shakes, never self-harms, and recovers faster, but the radius and knockback are narrower.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.preference.ai.m: The companion only considers thrashing when the threat is this close; smaller waits until contact, larger closes in first.
At least this many non-allies must stand inside the flail radius before thrashing; larger only uses it when surrounded, 1 uses it on sight.
worldcombat.skill.thrash.preference.ai.l: On: leaves a hold or stay post to push into a crowd. Off: only thrashes when it reaches someone from where it stands.
